findings.claim: The fix depends on copies_skills and TARGET_PATHS[claude] being defined wherever skill_registry.sh is sourced; the diff does not show either definition or a guard. If the file is sourced without them, an unset skills_root would be passed to the engine silently. The test covers only opencode, so a target other than opencode that does not copy skills is unverified.

evidence: The diff changes repair_sdd_registry_file to use the Claude skills root when copies_skills is false for the target; the golden file and the new test are consistent with that change.
copies_skills and TARGET_PATHS are not defined in the diff, so their availability at the call site cannot be confirmed from it.
The new test sets up a stray OpenCode copy of sdd-verify and asserts it is absent, which exercises the intended behavior for opencode.
